## English translation

### Robin Hood CZ look

By [saver](https://www.sector.sk/redaktor/saver.htm), 17 February 2003 at 18:54, under games

I have just looked at **Robin Hood: Legend of Sherwood** in the Czech version, and I have to say that the Czech localization is really high quality. The title intro is superbly dubbed, as are the voices of the individual characters during the game; although in the game they are now just shouts, such as _“To arms!”_ and similar, it sounds quite good and complements the translation of all the texts, especially the scrolls. I definitely recommend the game to all fans of Commandos or Desperados, and especially to those who found these games difficult. You can find the [review here](http://www.sector.sk/clanok.asp?id=6363), and you can [buy the game here](http://shop.sector.sk/detail.aspx?co=1&id=2645) for 1,290 Sk. Here are a few shots from the Czech version:

## Original text

### Robin Hood CZ look

pridal [saver](https://www.sector.sk/redaktor/saver.htm) 17.2.2003 o 18:54 pod hry

> Práve som si pozrel **Robina Hooda Legendu Sherwoodu** v českej verzií a musím povedať že čeština je tam naozaj kvalitná. Super nadabované je titulné intro a aj hlasy jednotlivých postáv počas hry, síce v hre sú to už len výkriky, ako _Do střehu_ a podobné, ale znie to celkom dobre a dobre to dopĺňa preloženie všetky textov a hlavne zvitkov. Určite hru odporúčam všetkým fanúšikom Commandos, alebo Desperados a hlavne tým ktorým sa tieto hry zdali ťažké. Recenziu [nájdete tu](http://www.sector.sk/clanok.asp?id=6363) a hru [môžete kúpiť tu](http://shop.sector.sk/detail.aspx?co=1&id=2645) za 1290 Sk. Tu je pár shotov z českej verzie:
